2: kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ |
3: tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ |
4: niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama |
5: yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat |
yajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām ||
6: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha |
kartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam ||
8: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet |
sa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet ||
9: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna |
saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ chaiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ||
10: na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate |
11: na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ |
yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate ||
12: aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam |
bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit ||
14: adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham |
vividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam ||
15: nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ ||
16: tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ |
paśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ ||
17: yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate |
hatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate ||
19: jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ |
prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api ||
20: avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam ||
21: pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān |
vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam ||
22: yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam |
atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam ||
23: aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate ||
24: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ |
25: anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham |
mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate ||
28: viṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate ||
29: buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu |
30: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye |
bandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
31: yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha |
ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
32: adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā |
sarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
34: prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
35: yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha |
na vimuñchati durmedhā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
36: sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha |
abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ cha nigachchhati |
yat tad agre viṣham iva pariṇāme ‘mṛitopamam |
37: yat  tad agre    viṣam   iva pariṇāme    'mṛtopamam  tat sukhaṁ  sāttvikaṁ   proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam ||
38: pariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam ||
39: yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ |
40: na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ |
sattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ ||
42: śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha |
43: śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam |
dānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam ||
45: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ |
sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu ||
46: yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam |
sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ ||
48: saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet |
50: siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||
51: buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha |
śhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha ||
53: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham |
54: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati |
samaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām ||
55: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ |
tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram ||
58: atha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi ||
59: yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase |
mithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati ||
60: kartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat ||
62: tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata |
tat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam ||
63: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā |
64: sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ |
iṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam ||
65: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru |
mām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me ||
66: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja |
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ ||
67: na chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi ||
68: ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati |
bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ ||
69: na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ |
bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ||
70: adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ |
jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ ||
71: śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ |
so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām ||
72: kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā |
73: naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta |
74: ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ |
75: vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param |
yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam ||
76: rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam |
keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ ||
77: tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ |
vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ ||
78: yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ |
tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama ||
